description.value: A combined fMRI and experience-sampling study examined motivational and neural correlates of self-control of eating in dieting female college students.

spans.text: the present study examined the relationship between college-aged dieters' daily experiences of desire and mood and their self-control, with a focus on motivational and neural correlates of differences observed in these self-regulatory processes.

description.value: Functional EPI data were slice-time corrected, realigned within and across runs to correct for head movement, unwarped to reduce residual movement-related distortions, normalized to the SPM8 EPI template corresponding to the ICBM 152/MNI brain atlas, and spatially smoothed with a 6-mm FWHM Gaussian kernel. The preprocessing was intended to remove artifact and noise and prepare the data for voxel-wise GLM analysis.
